newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise July rubber futures margin fee.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise July rubber futures margin fee.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Monday it would raise margin requirements on its July rubber futures contract by 10,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Tuesday.
Following the move, the total margin requirement for the July rubber futures contract will become 72,500 yen, TOCOM said in a statement.
It said the move was intended to cool overheated trade.
Margin fees on other contracts would remain unchanged at 97,750 yen for the June contract and 52,500 yen for the August, September, October and November contracts, TOCOM said.
